name: Synphony
long_description:
Strawberry farming is a $3B industry in California alone with 60% labor cost using 40-year old software. Synphony provides strawberry picking robots and software services including: bed-level analytics, data pipeline integration, and agentic solutions.

Synphony's "side hustle" is selling data, evals, and viral demos to robot foundation labs while building capacity for general robot deployments. We've started with strawberry farming for great margins and outdoor data moat, but also received requests for robots in semi-conductors and autonomous space labs. 

Synphony's team has won over 15 hackathons together (taking home 4 Jensen-signed GPUs!). Sean did ML research at NVIDIA and led AI products used by IRS and Citibank. Lucas' research spanned robotics, IoT devices, and neuromorphic computing. Alex architected an app with 400k users.

launches.title: Synphony - Automating Agriculture With Robots
launches.body:
We're building robots that pick strawberries.

California strawberries are a $3B industry. \~60% of that is labor cost — and that cost keeps climbing while the workforce shrinks. Growers are losing harvests they can't afford to pick. We’re working with California’s largest strawberry producers to solve this problem.

We send robots into the field to pick the fruit. Lower cost per pound, higher yield per acre, and software that finally replaces tools the industry has been running on for 40 years.

Robots just hit the crossover point with field labor. Strawberries are the wedge. Berries are $15B. Every other outdoor task — row crops, manufacturing lines, defense, anywhere robots have to actually show up and work — runs on the same deployment layer.

Synphony (YC W26). If you grow berries, invest in robotics, or want to build robots that do real work outdoors, let's talk.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2DJM9p5Lnk4>
